record.question: Prohibition of intoxicating drinks is found in which part / schedule of the Constitution of India?
record.explanation: Answer B: Part-IV. Article 47 in Part IV (Directive Principles) directs the State to prohibit intoxicating drinks injurious to health. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
